core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haadee corresponds to the Arabic form هادي (Arabic root ه د ي (h-d-y); هادٍ (hādī)). Its core sense is guide, leader. Haadee is Arabic هادي (Hādī) 'guide, one who guides aright', from the root ه د ي (h-d-y). The source glossed it 'delightful, beautiful, pleasing' — that belongs to a different root — and labelled it female; both were corrected. The word هادٍ appears in the Qur'an (e.g. 25:31) and al-Hādī is used of God.
